instruction: A candid studio photograph, captured in a full shot from a slightly high angle. In a minimalist indoor studio with a white background and floor, three barefoot friends sit together. On the left, the woman with wavy light brown hair (R3), wearing a black crop top, white shirt, and blue jeans, laughs while looking right. In the center, the woman with straight dark hair (R2), in a white top, denim jacket, and black pants, laughs heartily. On the right, the woman with curly brown hair (R1), in a white shirt and blue jeans, laughs joyfully. The friends sit on the floor, with the woman on the left (R3) reaching her arm towards the center woman (R2) as they share a playful laugh under bright, even studio lighting.
